subject: general
question: The Tata Iron and Steel Company Limited (TISCO) was started in the year ________ at Sakchi in Jharkhand state.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1907**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Tata Iron and Steel Company Limited (TISCO)** was started in the year **1907**.
 
• It was established at **Sakchi in Jharkhand state**, which is now known as Jamshedpur.
 
• TISCO was the first integrated steel plant in India and played a crucial role in the industrial development of the country.
 
• The company was founded by **Jamsetji Tata** and has been a significant contributor to India's steel industry.
 
• Over the years, TISCO has grown and evolved, becoming one of the largest steel manufacturers in the world, now known as **Tata Steel**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tata Steel** is part of the Tata Group, one of India's largest and oldest conglomerates.
 
• The company has operations in over 26 countries and a commercial presence in more than 50 countries.
 
• Tata Steel's products include a wide range of steel products like flat steel products, long steel products, and steel tubes.
 
• The company is known for its commitment to sustainability and corporate social responsibility.
 
• Tata Steel has received numerous awards and recognitions for its innovation, quality, and sustainability efforts.
